name: dtgsk
title: DT-GSK algorithm flowchart
note: Single source of truth for the DT-GSK process flowchart. Node order and text track Algorithm 1 and the frozen code; type 'ism_added' marks the mechanisms DT-GSK adds to the GSK skeleton (drawn with a light shaded fill, matching the TikZ 'new' style). Coordinates are Visio inches, origin bottom-left, values are shape centers.

nodes.text: Initialize NP=5D, KF, KR, Kexp, p; open 13 RNG substreams for dimension D
Calculate the fitness of each person; identify the global best
Reduce NP by NLPSR; assign each person its (KF, KR, Kexp) by the ACE selector
Compute the gained and shared dimensions (experience equation)
Apply the junior and senior gaining-sharing knowledge phases
Apply the linkage-aware block crossover mask (D≥10; else the KR mask)
Repair bounds, evaluate, and greedily accept no-worse trials
[D≥50] update the interaction-structure memory (ISM) from strictly improving accepted moves
Update the ACE credit and prune stalled arms (ARGP)
If stagnating, apply the budget-safe escape (BSE)
Run the coordinate local search (gated at [D≥100] by the budget/ROI controller)
[D≥50] once, in the final budget slice, apply the eigenframe polish
Update the global best (never loses ground)
If a deep stall is detected, restart the population and keep the best
